Title: Awakening
Description: Ryan wakes disoriented inside a malfunctioning cryopod on a damaged ship.

Title: Release Hatch
Description: Still trapped inside the pod, Ryan searches for a way out near the hatch.

Title: Outside Cryopod
Description: Ryan steps out into the cryobay, surrounded by other pods and failing systems.

Title: Cryobay Search
Description: Ryan searches the damaged cryobay for clues or supplies.

Title: Medkit Found
Description: Ryan discovers a cracked medkit under a fallen panel.

Title: Cryopod Body
Description: Ryan examines a nearby pod and finds a lifeless crewmate inside.

Title: Exposed Wiring
Description: Live, sparking cables block the exit from the cryobay.

Title: Corridor Encounter
Description: In the corridor outside the cryobay, Ryan meets Irene and Darius.

Title: Team: Hallway
Description: Ryan, Irene, and Darius move together down a damaged hallway.

Title: Alone: Hallway
Description: Ryan walks the corridor alone toward the maintenance section.

Title: Maintenance Airlock Hub (TEAM)
Description: The team reaches the locked airlock hub with a dead control panel.

Title: Maintenance Corridor (ALONE)
Description: Alone, Ryan reaches a dead airlock door and a nearby vent.

Title: Ventilation Shaft
Description: Ryan prepares to crawl into the ship's ventilation system.

Title: Ventilation Fan
Description: A powerful fan blocks the duct; a maintenance terminal sits nearby.

Title: Generator Room
Description: The team enters the backup generator room to restore power.

Title: Escape Pods Online (TEAM GOOD)
Description: With power restored, the team reaches working escape pods and launches.

Title: Powerless Drift (TEAM BAD)
Description: A failed restart leaves the ship dark and drifting in space.

Title: Cockpit Control (ALONE GOOD)
Description: Ryan reaches the cockpit, activates the beacon, and escapes alone.

Title: Fan Death (ALONE BAD)
Description: A fatal attempt at the ventilation fan ends Ryan's journey.
